name: Japan Expo
blurb: Europe's largest Japanese pop-culture convention, held at Paris-Nord Villepinte with anime, manga, music, gaming and cosplay guests.

editions.venue: Parc des Expositions de Paris-Nord Villepinte
textOnlyGuests: Captain Tsubasa creator, Japan Expo 2027 guest of honor
editions.evidence: Homepage countdown: 'Japan Expo 2027 commence dans... 276 JOURS' with 'Quand... Du 8 au 11 Juillet 2027' and 'L'invité d'honneur n'est autre que Yôichi Takahashi.'

notes: The homepage mixes a recap of the just-finished 2026 edition ('Revivez l'édition 2026', guest cards for Keisuke Itagaki, YOSHIKI, Kazuya Kamenashi, Junya Enoki, Shigenori Soejima, Kazuhisa Wada — all excluded here as past) with the countdown/announcement for the next edition, 8-11 July 2027. The jep27 guests sub-page (/fr/editions/jep27/invites) only shows day-filter tabs and a stale 'old edition' banner with zero guest cards yet, so the sole confirmed 2027 guest so far is the guest of honor named on the homepage, recorded as text-only (no photo found). Guest-freshness recheck (verify-06, 2026-10-05): confirmed current — the homepage now explicitly reads 'Merci à tous ! Rendez-vous l'année prochaine ! L'édition de cette année est terminée... on se retrouve du 8 au 11 juillet 2027. L'invité d'honneur n'est autre que Yôichi Takahashi', an official post-show announcement naming him for the 2027 dates, while the jep27 guest subpage itself still self-flags as 'une ancienne édition' with zero guest cards. Refute-03 recheck (2026-10-05): tried to refute, upheld -- a fresh fetch of the actual homepage still reads verbatim '...L'édition de cette année est terminée. Mais on se retrouve du 8 au 11 juillet 2027. L'invité d'honneur n'est autre que Yôichi Takahashi', a dated post-show announcement naming him for next edition's exact dates (proof type b).
